en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a wooded mountain valley with tall conifer trees, a rocky stream in the foreground, a small wooden footbridge crossing the water, and people standing near the stream and bridge. In the distance, on a higher ridge above the forest, there are several large buildings. The caption at the top reads "Parthie im Rabenauergrunde." On the right margin, vertically, appears a printer or publisher line with a number.
